title: ''You Can't Open an LLM With a Screwdriver'': The De-Democratization of Software
abstract: arXiv:2608.24720v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Claims that generative AI will soon write all of the code have led to predictions that programming is nearing its end. In this vision paper, we argue against this assumption that broader access to code generation necessarily democratizes software development, i.e., everyone can code but we have to distinguish between access and control: by access, we mean the ability of more people, including non-experts and less-experienced developers, to generate code-like artifacts with AI; by control, we mean the capacity to inspect, evaluate, integrate, maintain, and govern those artifacts as dependable software. While AI may broaden access to code production, control may become more concentrated among those who own or understand the code, software practices, infrastructure, evaluation practices, and deployment pipelines.   Grounded in an expert panel, our vision paper argues that AI does not eliminate software engineering expertise but shifts where

translated_title: “你不能用螺丝刀打开大语言模型”：软件的非民主化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24720v1 公告类型：新公告 摘要：声称生成式AI将很快编写所有代码的论断，引发了编程即将终结的预测。在这篇愿景论文中，我们反对这一假设，即更广泛的代码生成访问必然会使软件开发民主化，即每个人都能编程，但我们必须区分访问与控制：访问，我们指的是更多人（包括非专家和经验较少的开发者）能够使用AI生成类似代码的产物；控制，我们指的是检查、评估、集成、维护和管理这些产物作为可靠软件的能力。虽然AI可能扩大代码生产的访问范围，但控制权可能变得更加集中在那些拥有或理解代码、软件实践、基础设施、评估实践和部署流程的人手中。基于专家小组的讨论，我们的愿景论文认为，AI并未消除软件工程专业知识，而是转移了其重心。
tldr: 本文指出，生成式AI虽能扩大代码生成的访问范围，但不会实现软件开发的民主化，反而可能加剧控制权的集中，因为软件工程的专业知识并未消失，而是转移到了新的领域。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that while generative AI broadens access to code generation, it does not democratize software development; instead, it may concentrate control, as software engineering expertise shifts rather than disappears.
